defects.description: The term 'safe value' is incorrectly translated as 'безопасного замечания' (safe remark/note). In this technical context, 'value' should be 'значение'.
The term 'applied defaults' is incorrectly translated as 'применённые замечания по умолчанию' (applied remarks by default). 'Defaults' here refers to 'default values' (значения по умолчанию).
